notes:
Inbound SMB lead via blog post demo. CTO (Rina Park) signed up for free credits yesterday and ran a few toy prompts. Immediate interest: replace current multi-model chain that is expensive and brittle.

=== Discovery call (2026-03-09) summary ===
- Rina (CTO) + 2 engineers. Looking for hosted API; wants low-friction self-serve POC.
- Primary workloads: customer support triage + short answer generation (chat), product doc search (embeddings), and periodic reranking for search results.
- Latency target: 95th perc < 300ms for chat in US regions; ok to trade off for embeddings (batchable).
- Throughput: modest, peaks ~150 qps during daytime.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Budget constraint for first year. Wants to compare Llama/Mistral/Qwen family tradeoffs (7B vs 13B) for quality/cost.
- Model preferences observed: tested Llama-2-7B locally, liked response style but saw hallucination on procedures. Curious about Mistral mixes for instruction tuning. Interested in Qwen variants for code/specialized prompts.
- Asked: "how much better is 13B vs 7B for our use?" and "what quantized options do you expose on hosted API and how does that affect latency/cost?"
- Security: must have SSO/SAML for dev accounts, SOC2 compliance, retention controls and audit logs for support transcripts.
- Residency: US-only data preferred but no strict legal residency yet.

=== Technical notes from SE (Liam) ===
- Recommended approach: run parallel A/B in hosted API using Llama-2-7B (cheap baseline) vs Mistral-7B-instruct (balanced) vs Qwen-14B-lite (higher quality, higher cost) on same prompt set. Use Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and KV caching on chat sessions to reduce tokens.
- Suggest starting with quantized variants where available (int8/ptq) to reduce per-token cost; measure delta in hallucination rate on standard prompt set.
- POC plan: 2-week hosted POC, 2 evaluation prompts sets (support triage + doc search queries), automated eval harness (we'll provide rubric). Need token budget estimate from them.
- Integration ask: quick SDK examples (node/python) + tenant-level API key management.

=== Commercial notes ===
- SMB pricing likely; they want estimate for 12-month run if POC successful. ARR ask small but high chance to expand if latency/cost targets met.
- Upsell potential: Redwood Optimize and Dedicated if throughput grows.

=== Conversation quotes ===
- Rina: "We can tolerate slightly lower quality on routing prompts if it cuts cost in half — but not on final answer generation."
- Engineer (Tom): "How transparent are the per-route latency and token cost breakdowns? We need that for our cost model."

=== Action items ===
- Maya to send tailored cost vs quality matrix with sample token cost scenarios (2026-03-15).
- Liam to attach short POC playbook + prompt eval harness (drive link).
- Legal to be looped with security FAQ (Maya to share security deck).

Notes tone: shorthand, action-oriented. Follow-ups scheduled next week for POC kickoff.
